en: The image shows the front and back of an old postcard. The front side features a sepia-toned photograph of a damaged or destroyed iron bridge, likely from wartime, with the label 'Eisenbahnbrücke bei Görz' (Railway bridge near Gorizia). The back side contains handwritten text in German, postal markings, and stamps, indicating it was sent through the mail, possibly during a period of conflict. The logos of the National and University Library of Slovenia and the Digital Library of Slovenia appear in the corners.
